name: cbio-brca-aurora-2023
alternateName: Metastatic Breast Cancer (AURORA US Network, Nat Cancer 2023)
description: Whole exome and low-pass whole genome sequencing of 55 patients with metastatic breast cancer (53 primary cancers and 102 metastases) and their matched normals. Retrospective Tissue Collection; an initiative of the Breast Cancer Research Foundation.
